module: "Color History" section of the Dynamic Decals tool. Keeps in an editor preference (`dynamicDecalsTool.colorHistory.history`) the list of the last used colors (RGBA) and lets you reapply them as a decal or fill layer color, or delete them. The maximum size is the `maxHistoryCount` preference (default 10, from 2 to 128).
notes: addColorToHistory reads color.x/.y/.z/.w: it needs a Point4F/vec4-type value, not an {r,g,b,a} table.
In addColorToHistory, table.remove is called during ipairs: at most one duplicate is handled correctly.
Deleting a color in onGui modifies the table during ipairs; harmless since the loop continues on the shortened table.

addColorToHistory.desc: Adds the color at the head of the history (first removes an identical entry), truncates to maxHistoryCount and saves the preference.

color.desc: Color with fields x, y, z, w (RGBA).

onGui.desc: Draws the list: a widget for each color, the buttons "Set as decal color" (api.setDecalColor), "Set as fill layer color" (api.setFillLayerColor) and a delete icon. Used as the section content and as the editor of the `history` preference.

guiId.desc: Suffix to make ImGui identifiers unique.

registerEditorPreferences.desc: Registers the subcategory `dynamicDecalsTool.colorHistory`: `history` (table, edited by onGui) and `maxHistoryCount` (int, default 10, min 2, max 128).

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets the API and docs, registers the "Color History" section (order 122) and its documentation page.
